target.statement: Average PSNR of 29.90 dB for the unenhanced compressed video baseline in Track 1 (quality enhancement), computed over 15 test videos.

compute.basis: The baseline is just the compressed test videos; reproducing it requires downloading the LDV 2.0 test split, running the provided HEVC HM 16.20 encoding command (or using pre-encoded files if available), and computing PSNR against ground truth. No training or GPU is needed, but the HM encoder is slow and the dataset is large.

blockers: HM 16.20 encoder must be built from source (no prebuilt binary provided)
Dataset download is large (hundreds of GB for full LDV 2.0; test split alone may be tens of GB)
Exact PSNR may differ slightly due to encoder version/configuration details
title: NTIRE 2022 Challenge on Super-Resolution and Quality Enhancement of Compressed Video: Dataset, Methods and Results
